nodes.label: GEMINI_API_KEY env var (optional)
nodes.rationale: Optional: setting it is what enables the Daily Summary feature.

nodes.label: data/news_archive.json (3-day feed item archive)
nodes.rationale: Every feed item is archived (kept 3 days) because the RSS feed only holds about 25 items, which is not enough to cover the previous 24 hours for the Daily Summary.

nodes.label: Health check endpoint (/health on port 3000)
nodes.rationale: Exposed via Elysia so cloud platforms can run health checks against the bot.

nodes.label: Volume persistence (/app/data mount)
nodes.rationale: A volume must be mounted so channels.json and news_state.json are saved to a virtual disk; without it the bot loses all data on every redeploy or restart.
